import json
n=30
g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
# Square frame occupies rows/cols 1..25. Concentric border colors follow
# observed sequence: depth 0 is 5, then repeat 2,5,0,5.
colors=[5]
pattern=[2,5,0,5]
for d in range(1,13): colors.append(pattern[(d-1)%4])
for d,color in enumerate(colors):
    lo=1+d; hi=25-d
    for c in range(lo,hi+1):
        g[lo][c]=color; g[hi][c]=color
    for r in range(lo,hi+1):
        g[r][lo]=color; g[r][hi]=color
assert len(g)==30 and all(len(row)==30 for row in g)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g}))
